meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行生成预览、渲染和发布超帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常用命令行工具制作动画或视频并需要高效渲染
copy.tagline_en: Generate, preview, render, and publish hyperframe animations from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use CLI tools to create animations or videos and need efficient rendering

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令，帮你完成视频合成项目的初始化、检查、预览和渲染等步骤。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或编辑 HyperFrames 视频合成项目，或者诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个新项目。
检查当前项目有没有问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run HyperFrames CLI commands to help you scaffold, check, preview, and render video composition projects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or edit a HyperFrames video composition project, or when diagnosing build/render failures.

say_en.note: Runs `npx hyperframes init` to scaffold a project directory.

say_en.text: Check the current project for issues.
say_en.note: Runs `npx hyperframes check` which includes lint and runtime audit.
Runs `npx hyperframes preview` to open the Studio preview.
